name: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest toothpaste and toothbrush company (Colgate Strong Teeth, MaxFresh, Total, Vedshakti, Visible White; Palmolive, mouthwash). Debt-free, ROCE 108%, payout 112%. TTM sales Rs 6,391 cr (+9%), EBITDA Rs 1,908 cr (30%), PAT Rs 1,362 cr. Sep-26 quarter: sales Rs 1,706 cr (+12%), OPM 28% (31% a year ago), PAT Rs 342 cr (+4%), interim dividend Rs 24; the company stepped up advertising (Exchange4Media 2026-10-22). Stock Rs 1,688 hit a 52-week low on 2026-10-22; -23% 12m. Parent Colgate-Palmolive (US) holds 51%.
